description: Find the US Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification for a product. Returns candidate HTS codes with their official descriptions and base duty rates. Use when the user wants the code itself rather than a cost.

query.description: Product description, e.g. "cotton t-shirts" or "lithium ion batteries".

name: classify_hts

results.description: Candidates ranked by text match, not a classification ruling.

priceable.description: False for 4 and 6 digit headings, which carry no rate and cannot be priced.

title: Find HTS classification codes
